fields.name: header_magic_u32
fields.evidence: Header RAM0 reconstructed from both .sav files =0xc0deb00b; FUN_0802d1c4 compares *header to a ROM constant, FUN_0802d1d8 writes it. Logical RAM image offset 0x00, file offset 0x04.

fields.name: header_boot_counter_u8
fields.evidence: FUN_0802d1bc writes byte at header+4, FUN_0802d1c0 reads it; value 16 observed in RAM image in both files. Logical RAM offset 0x04, file offset 0x03. Semantics as boot/session counter inferred, not proven by gameplay.

fields.name: header_reserved_u8_5
fields.evidence: Logical RAM offset 0x05, file offset 0x0A. Part of header bytes 5-7 = FF FF FF in both samples.

fields.name: header_reserved_u16_6
fields.evidence: Logical RAM offset 0x06, file offsets 0x08-0x09.

fields.name: slot_magic_or_empty_sentinel_u32
fields.evidence: RAM slot+0x00. File slot0 offset 0x0C, slot1 0x84, slot2 0xFC. Values proven by reconstruction+CRC match on all 6 slot instances. ROM literal values themselves not readable in decompiled.c (DAT placeholders), inferred uniquely from .sav+code structure.

fields.name: slot_field_04_u8_obj48_or_58
fields.evidence: RAM slot+0x04, file slot0 0x0B. Conditional-write quirk: skipped if obj+0xa0!=0 or FUN_080170e4!=0.

fields.name: slot_field_05_u8_obj50_or_60
fields.evidence: RAM slot+0x05, file slot0 0x0A. Same conditional-write quirk as +0x04.

fields.name: slot_field_07_u8_obj58
